description: This file contains a test suite for the 'Viewer WindowManager' component, utilizing Protractor for end-to-end testing. It sets up the test environment, uploads a trace fixture, interacts with UI elements, and verifies the presence of the viewer window.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Initializes the browser environment before running the test suite, setting implicit wait times and navigating to the production index HTML page.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines a test case that uploads a trace fixture, interacts with UI elements to open the viewer, and verifies that the viewer component is present on the page.
